population: All senior men's J1 regular-season matches in the two consecutive Beijing intervals, verified against the retained annual ESPN scoreboard and current raw calendar or event confirmations. Keep every registered slot, original identity, known schedule revision, missing issue and unresolved result. An additional eligible fixture outside the registration must be disclosed as incomplete first-issue coverage.
author_method: Before the earliest kickoff of each window, freeze the registered Current and Test artifacts on the same verified fixture. Compare those matrices with supported recent goals and chance creation, venue, personnel, schedule and the actual market evidence. Author the single first score and two distinct ordered alternatives, with independent WDL and actual-line side where supported. Preserve original content, each first-issue expiry, evidence and publication time. Require independently read back first delivery and certified regulation result for formal display credit.
selection: Rank the eligible authored first scores in each full registered window by the geometric mean of the two unchanged model probabilities of that actual chosen cell. Break ties by kickoff and stable fixture ID. Lock up to three distinct selected matches before the first kickoff. Three selected firsts must all hit to count a complete sweep; all short or unresolved batches retain their planned slots.
market: Use a same-book and same-cutoff 1X2 and real totals market. Strict totals require named book, actual line and both prices, provider quote time, observed timestamp and age no greater than 3600 seconds at selection. The source clock must be attached to the preserved bookmaker object. Retain observed-only lines separately. The full-win denominator excludes pushes; report five-way settlements and matched market deltas.
stopping: Apply project-goals.json's registered thresholds independently in both windows. For the first stage this is first score 20%, ordered three 40%, WDL 65%, strict actual-line full wins 70% and selected first-score sweep 100%, with the same coverage minima as the original ten-match window. Report both windows, coverage and any reason for incomplete certification. Keep prior weeks and their original results independent. Historical R26 and prior paper reviews are outside the new validation windows. No automatic promotion.
